create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent ID index from the solvent database pickle file
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of solvent molecules per angstrom cubed using the molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_length: get the number of atoms in a Solvent object using the len function
get_solvent_name: get the solvent name as a string using the str function on a Solvent object
